A host kernel vulnerability affects machines running many containers. The team is determining which software layer needs remediation.

Which TWO statements correctly describe shared kernel and the relevant operational constraints? Select exactly two answers.
options: Each container always has an independent kernel
Updating only application packages patches the host kernel
Kernel vulnerabilities can cross container isolation boundaries
Host patching remains important even with minimal images

questions.objective: Explain shared kernel and apply it to an operational decision.
questions.takeaway: Host patching remains important even with minimal images.
questions.explanation: Kernel vulnerabilities can cross container isolation boundaries. Host patching remains important even with minimal images. In the operational case, the appropriate response is: assess host exposure and roll out host remediation safely. A kernel defect can affect multiple containers and the host. Namespaces, cgroups, seccomp and privilege restrictions provide different layers of protection. Containers are not equivalent to independent virtual-machine kernels.
